source_contract: SetWindowDirty, SetWindowWidgetDirty, SetWindowClassesDirty, InvalidateWindowData, InvalidateWindowClassesData, CloseWindowById (window.cpp) and DeleteNewGRFInspectWindow (newgrf_debug_gui.cpp) stay native until the GUI is ported; services.cpp binds their table once before main, as it binds the news table.
reason: `#[unsafe(no_mangle)]` on the export and the dereference of the process-lifetime table pointer are unsafe code; the crate denies it outside item-scoped allows.
retirement_condition: When the native window bodies this table calls are ported (phase 5) and the table is removed.

source_contract: `CmdStartStopVehicle` (src/vehicle_cmd.cpp) is one body: its NewGRF start/stop callback checks and its execution, which ends with four window calls.
reason: #979 writes the original's four window calls at the site in place of the one-site startstop_ui leaf, taking the ported body from 100 to 115 lines; splitting it would add a function the original does not have.
retirement_condition: None while the body follows the original; a later port that shares part of it with another command removes the allow.

reason: The process-wide binding entry of the shared window table, called once from services.cpp. It replaces 33 one-site window and sound leaves and the 4 integrated window copies of the objectives and settings tables; each later conversion of a window leaf is a net deletion.
existing_alternatives: A pointer to the window table in every component table, two C++ lines per table, as #974's plan decision 9 rejected for the news table.
retirement_condition: When the native window bodies are ported and the table is removed.

reason: `_settings_client.gui.population_in_label` joins the settings address catalog so ChangePopulation's port reads it at its original observation point; the deleted RustTown_population_changed leaf read it in C++. One generated field per original setting, as #965 and #970 did.
existing_alternatives: No Rust reader of the setting existed; a per-setting service would be a callback slot.
retirement_condition: The field stays while the settings table is native; it retires when Rust owns _settings_client.
